verdict.rationale: Slack's Events API is a well-documented webhook-style subscription system: apps can 'subscribe to only the events you want' and Slack pushes events via a public HTTP endpoint (or Socket Mode) so 'Slack calls you.' Workflow Builder also supports webhook triggers to start workflows from outside Slack, reinforcing agentic/event-driven integration patterns. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation of the Events API webhook delivery in production and more detail on payload/retry semantics beyond docs claims.
